title: Money in everyday life / film

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Connect interface information to human situations so financial actions have understandable consequences.
strategic_value: Scenes of shopping, family transfers and dining can make Wise’s account functions feel relevant across different lives.
demonstration: The film follows people using phones and cards, overlays enlarged interface panels and moves from individual use to a restaurant group.
practical_value: Choose which interface details clarify the action without overwhelming the photographed person.
